note: The Gate C work order, authored from verified data. Blueprint 7.1 fixes the ten narratives; the Phase 0 snapshot (docs/understanding.md section 8, .crown/notes.md, content/sources.json) fixes the articles. Stage A1 reads this file and nothing else. Every `headline` marked `reconstructed: true` is a description of the claim, NOT a verbatim title: nobody recorded the exact wording, and inventing one and printing it as a quotation would be the thing this product exists to catch. Verbatim titles are copied character for character from content/sources.json, which is where their liveness and retrieval date are recorded. Leans, tags, panel plans and scaffold defaults are the 7.1 defaults the run starts from; A7 and A9 may narrow them, and a gate may reject them.
